reviewer.independence: Independent of closeout-helper author /root. Curator of manganese records and author of frontier builder; not an independent review of own scientific records or frontier report.

scope: Static review of the closeout helper only. No execution, GitHub publication or Git mutation.

source.snapshot_basis: Exact original source reconstructed from the complete earlier tool output after a concurrent author edit. SHA computed at reconstruction, not captured contemporaneously with the initial read.

findings.title: Closeout claims exceed its explicit receipt bindings
findings.evidence: The helper loads postmerge but not preflight; its body claims both isolated runs verified absent topic objects. Hardcoded 317/3 and 312/362/373/68/312 are not compared with completed postmerge counts/log or config, and clean_detached_worktree is not asserted before the body claims it.
findings.correction_required: Bind and hash-check the completed preflight receipt and log; assert topic absence for both runs; compare expected counts with completed verification receipts/config and derive or validate test totals from the completed postmerge log; assert clean_detached_worktree before writing/publishing the body.
findings.risk: A stale or mismatched operational receipt could allow the automated PR comment to overstate completed verification. This does not invalidate the seven scientific records.

unresolved_questions: Actual publication receipts do not exist yet; runtime success is not assessed.

provenance_correction.detail: Initial uncommitted draft inadvertently hashed the already-corrected current helper during concurrent editing. Replaced that draft input with a separately retained reconstruction of the source actually reviewed; corrected-current source is reviewed separately.
